rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2010).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2010 as 'Anne Birnhak'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
